answers.core: It is an improvement to a built in node and not something that could easily be in an add-on. I do not the know the full extent of what addons can do, so I am likely not the best person to determine this.
answers.workaround: It is necessary to teleport rigidbodies into the desired position before attaching, this can be fairly buggy and undesirable, especially when using physics interpolation.
